info.title: Clickwise Publisher API
info.description: One publisher API key for products, programs, tracking links, conversions, reports, clicks and conversion postbacks. Every response carries RateLimit-* and X-Request-Id headers; errors share one shape. Changes inside v1 are additive; a breaking change ships as a new version, announced in advance through Deprecation and Sunset headers. The same capabilities are available to AI agents through the MCP server at https://partners.clickwise.net/api/v1/mcp and to HasOffers-compatible tools at https://partners.clickwise.net/Apiv3/json.

Conversion postback sent to your URL
post.description: Events sale.created, sale.approved, sale.declined, sale.reversed. Signature: hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<X-CW-Timestamp>." + message)); message = the full URL (GET) or the raw JSON body (POST). Retries with exponential backoff (up to 8 attempts, capped at 6 h).

X-Request-Id.description: Echoes a valid X-Request-Id, else generated.

E403.description: Not allowed for this key or account

E409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body

E503.description: Temporary dependency failure; retry with backoff
